title: PCR/qPCR prep: distribution of primers to 384-well plates
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Specify protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Using the parameter fields provided, enter a comma‑separated list of values that define the number of plates (up to nine), the fill level for each 384‑well plate, and any other required settings (e.g., which of the four primers go to which wells) before downloading the protocol.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Click the “Download your protocol” button to save the generated Opentrons protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App, go to the “Upload Protocol” section, and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the required labware on the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map: up to nine 384‑well plates in the specified slots, a P20‑multi‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette, and a tip rack of Opentrons 20 µL filter tips.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, run the calibration routine for the deck, the tip rack, and the P20‑multi‑channel pipette. Follow the on‑screen prompts (see the support article for details).

steps.title: Run the primer distribution
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App; the robot will dispense the four different primers into the wells of the 384‑well plates according to the attached plate map.
